terms.metaDescription: The terms of service for using Fakturcho.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms of service govern the relationship between {legalName} and any business or sole trader that uses the {productName} web application at {website} to compose and issue commercial documents. By registering an account, the user accepts the terms in this document.

sections.heading: 1. Service provider
paragraphs: The service is provided by {entityLine}, a company registered under Bulgarian law.
Contact us at {supportEmail}. We reply to inquiries within five business days.

sections.heading: 2. What the service is
paragraphs: {productName} is a web application through which a business or sole trader established in the European Union composes and issues commercial documents — invoices, proformas, credit and debit notes, quotes and delivery notes — and downloads them as a PDF file, together with a structured e-invoice file where the document type and the issuer's country call for one.

The application prepares documents from the data the user enters and applies the VAT rules of the issuer's own country. It is not an accounting service and does not replace accounting or tax advice. It does not submit anything to any tax authority or e-invoicing platform on the user's behalf: e-invoice files are generated ready for the user to download and upload themselves.
Each account represents a single issuer with its own list of clients, catalogue and numbering series.

sections.heading: 3. Registration and account
paragraphs: Using the service requires registration with a valid email address, a password, and the country in which the issuer is established. The user is responsible for safeguarding their access credentials and for all actions taken through their account.

The service is intended for businesses and sole traders (B2B) issuing commercial documents in the course of their trade or profession. Where a natural person registers for purposes outside any trade or profession, the consumer-protection provisions referenced in this document and in the Refund Policy apply to them.

The user represents that the data entered for the issuer and for clients is accurate and that they are entitled to process it. The content of issued documents, and its correctness under the tax law that applies to the issuer, is the user's sole responsibility.

sections.heading: 4. Prices and payment
paragraphs: Issuing each document costs {perDocument}, deducted from the account's credit balance the moment the document is assigned a number. Composing and saving drafts, clients and catalogue items is free.

Credit is topped up through one-off packs priced at {packs}. A subscription of {subscription} grants double that amount in credit every billing period. A subscription grants credit; it does not exempt any document from the {perDocument} issuance charge.
A new account receives a one-off credit of {signupGrant} on registration.

Payments are processed by {entityLine} through Revolut as the payment service provider. Prices are stated in euro. {legalName} is not currently VAT-registered, so no VAT is added to these amounts; if that changes, the applicable rate will be shown before payment.

sections.heading: 5. Credit
paragraphs: Credit is a prepaid value in euro cents that is used only to issue documents in the application. Credit has no expiry date and does not accrue interest.
Credit cannot be transferred between accounts and is not paid out in cash, except in the cases covered by the Refund Policy.

sections.heading: 6. User obligations
paragraphs: The user is solely responsible for complying with the accounting, tax and invoicing legislation that applies to their business in their own country, including any obligation to submit, declare or report issued documents to their national tax authority or e-invoicing platform. Fakturcho prepares the document and, where applicable, the e-invoice file ready for that step; it does not perform the submission itself.
It is prohibited to use the service to issue documents with untrue content, to circumvent tax obligations, or to take actions that infringe the rights of third parties.
Attempts at automated load, intrusion, or disruption of the service's operation result in immediate termination of access.

sections.heading: 7. Liability and availability
paragraphs: The service is provided as is. We make reasonable efforts to keep it available and accurate, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.
The provider is not liable for the accuracy of data entered by the user, nor for the tax or accounting consequences, in any country, of documents issued through the application.
The provider's liability for proven damages is limited to the amount paid by the user over the preceding twelve months.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
paragraphs: The user may stop using the service at any time by discontinuing access to their account and requesting its deletion at the email address given above.
The provider may terminate access in the event of a breach of these terms, notifying the user at their registered email address.
Issued documents remain the user's obligation under the accounting and tax legislation that applies to them, even after access is terminated.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: These terms may be amended. The current version is always available at this address, with the date of the last update. Material changes are communicated to the registered email address no later than fourteen days before they take effect.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: Bulgarian law governs these terms and any matter not covered here. For a business (B2B) user, a dispute is resolved by agreement and, failing that, by the competent court in Sofia, Bulgaria.

Where the user is a consumer within the meaning of applicable EU law, this choice of law does not deprive them of the mandatory consumer-protection provisions of the country in which they are habitually resident, and they may bring proceedings before the courts of that country or of Bulgaria. Every consumer may use the European Commission's online dispute resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr, or complain to the consumer protection authority of their own country — for a Bulgarian consumer, the Commission for Consumer Protection.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document explains what personal data {productName} processes, on what grounds, to whom it discloses it, and what rights each data subject has under the GDPR. The policy applies to the web application at {website} and to the businesses and individuals across the European Union who use it.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller is {entityLine}, email {supportEmail}.
For data the user enters about their own clients, the user is the controller and Fakturcho acts as a data processor on the user's instructions.

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: Account data: email address, name, a cryptographically hashed record of the password, and the country of establishment given at signup.
Issuer data: company name, national company or VAT identifier, address, authorized representative, bank account, and the person who drew up the document. This data is printed on issued documents.
Client and document data: the recipient's name and identifiers, addresses, catalogue items, amounts and dates, as entered by the user.
Technical data: access logs, request time, request address and response code, kept for security and troubleshooting purposes.

Analytics data: anonymized, cookieless product-usage events (pages viewed, features used), collected through our self-hosted Umami analytics instance. This data cannot be linked back to an identified visitor and is never shared with any advertising network.
We do not process special categories of personal data and we do not carry out automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal grounds
paragraphs: Providing the service and maintaining the account — processing is necessary for performance of the contract with the user.
Processing payments and keeping the credit balance — performance of a contract and compliance with legal obligations.
Service security, abuse prevention and technical support — the controller's legitimate interest.
Understanding and improving the service through anonymized product analytics — the controller's legitimate interest, balanced by the fact that the data cannot identify a visitor.
Compliance with the accounting and tax obligations that apply to us as controller — a legal obligation.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Revolut — processes payments as the payment service provider. Receives the email address and payment data. {productName} does not store bank card data.
Railway Corporation — hosting of the application, the database, and our self-hosted analytics instance.
Resend, Inc. — sending transactional emails when the user chooses to send a document by email.

Where a recipient processes data outside the European Economic Area, the transfer is based on the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission or another safeguard recognized by the GDPR.
We do not sell personal data and do not provide it for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Retention periods
paragraphs: Account data and content entered by the user is retained for as long as the account exists.
After a deletion request, data is removed within thirty days, except for records we are legally required to keep.
Technical access logs are retained for up to twelve months.

sections.heading: 6. Data subject rights
paragraphs: Every natural person has the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
These rights are exercised by a request to {supportEmail}. We reply within one month.

You may lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP), 2 Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov Blvd., Sofia 1592, www.cpdp.bg — or, under Article 77 of the GDPR, with the data protection supervisory authority of the EU member state of your habitual residence, your place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: We use only one strictly necessary cookie — a session cookie that keeps the account signed in. It is required for the service to work and does not require consent.

Our self-hosted product analytics (Umami) does not use cookies and does not track visitors across other sites. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies and do not embed third-party analytics scripts.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: Access to the application is password-protected and the connection is encrypted. Every account sees only its own data; separation is enforced at the database query level.

In the event of a security breach that creates a high risk to the rights of affected persons, we notify the Commission for Personal Data Protection and the affected persons within the applicable deadlines.

refunds.metaDescription: When and how Fakturcho refunds amounts paid.
refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.intro: This policy describes when and how amounts paid for credit and subscriptions in {productName} are refunded.

sections.heading: 1. Who processes payments
paragraphs: Payments are processed through Revolut as the payment service provider. Refunds are ordered by us to the same card or account used for the purchase.
A request is submitted to {supportEmail} with the order number from the payment confirmation.

sections.heading: 2. Unused credit
paragraphs: Unused credit is refunded in full on request within fourteen days of purchasing the pack, or of the payment that started a subscription period.
If part of a pack, or of a subscription period's credit, has been spent, the remainder corresponding to the unused amount is refunded.

sections.heading: 3. Used credit
paragraphs: Credit spent to issue a document is not refundable. Issuing claims a number from the numbering series and creates a commercial document — the service has been performed at that moment. The price for issuing a single document is {perDocument}. Composing drafts does not spend credit and is not charged.

Where the user is a consumer, issuing a document is an express request that this part of the service be performed immediately; by doing so, the consumer acknowledges that they lose the right of withdrawal for the credit spent on it, in accordance with Article 16(a) of Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights.

sections.heading: 4. Subscription
paragraphs: A subscription of {subscription} can be cancelled at any time. Access remains until the end of the paid period, after which it is not renewed.
The fee paid for the current period is not partially refunded, unless the service was unavailable through our fault for more than three consecutive days.

sections.heading: 5. Right of withdrawal for consumers
paragraphs: A consumer within the meaning of Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights, as implemented in the applicable national law, has the right to withdraw from a purchase of credit or a subscription within fourteen days of the purchase, without stating a reason, to the extent that the credit has not yet been spent to issue a document.
Where the consumer has expressly requested that the service begin immediately, as described in Section 3, the right of withdrawal is lost for the part already performed — the credit already spent.

sections.heading: 6. Processing time
paragraphs: Approved refunds are ordered within five business days. The time it takes for the amount to reach the payer's account depends on their bank or card issuer and is usually three to ten business days.
If a request is declined, you receive a reasoned reply at the email address it was submitted from.

pricing.heading: Precios

payAsYouGo.title: Pago por uso
payAsYouGo.body: Por cada documento que emita. Los borradores, clientes y artículos del catálogo son gratuitos. El crédito se recarga en paquetes de {packs}.

subscription.title: Suscripción
subscription.footnote: El crédito no utilizado se acumula. Puede cancelarla cuando quiera.

pricing.footnote: Una cuenta nueva recibe {signupGrant} de crédito al registrarse. Los pagos se procesan a través de Revolut.

items.question: ¿Qué es Fakturcho?
items.answer: Una aplicación web para emitir facturas, facturas proforma, facturas rectificativas, presupuestos y albaranes conformes con la normativa de la UE, con facturación electrónica estructurada integrada. No requiere instalación.

items.question: ¿Cuánto cuesta?
items.answer: 0,10 € por documento emitido; los borradores, clientes y artículos del catálogo son gratuitos; el crédito se recarga en paquetes de 5 €, 10 € y 25 €; las suscripciones de 5, 10 y 25 € al mes otorgan el doble de crédito, que se acumula; con una suscripción, cada documento cuesta 0,05 €.

items.question: ¿Se puede empezar gratis?
items.answer: Sí, una cuenta nueva recibe 1 € de crédito (10 documentos) sin necesidad de tarjeta.

items.question: ¿En qué países se puede usar?
items.answer: Cualquier empresa establecida en el territorio de aplicación del IVA de la UE puede emitir documentos. Para Alemania, Francia, Italia, Polonia, Rumanía y España se genera la factura electrónica estructurada en el formato nacional, lista para subir a la plataforma nacional; para Bulgaria, en el formato europeo EN 16931 (UBL).

items.question: ¿Cómo se gestiona el IVA para un cliente de otro país de la UE?
items.answer: Introduzca el NIF-IVA del cliente; Fakturcho lo verifica en VIES y, si se trata de un cliente B2B válido en el extranjero, aplica la inversión del sujeto pasivo e imprime la mención obligatoria en el documento.

items.question: ¿Puedo emitir facturas sin estar registrado a efectos de IVA?
items.answer: Depende del país. Bulgaria, Alemania (§ 19 UStG), Francia (franchise en base), Italia (regime forfettario), Polonia (art. 113) y Rumanía (art. 310) cuentan cada una con un régimen de exención para pequeños negocios, y Fakturcho imprime automáticamente el motivo de exención correspondiente. España no tiene un régimen general de exención para pequeños negocios: un emisor español no registrado a efectos de IVA debe seleccionar, para cada documento, la actividad exenta aplicable conforme al artículo 20 de la Ley del IVA.

items.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre una factura proforma y una factura?
items.answer: La factura proforma tiene el mismo aspecto que una factura y recoge los mismos datos, pero no genera ninguna obligación fiscal y no recibe número — se usa, por ejemplo, para solicitar un pago anticipado o para un trámite de aduana. La factura es el documento fiscal oficial, con número y fecha de la operación.

items.question: ¿Cómo se corrige una factura emitida?
items.answer: Los documentos emitidos son inmutables; las correcciones se hacen mediante una factura rectificativa de abono o de cargo referida al original.

items.question: ¿Cómo obtengo el PDF y el XML de la factura electrónica?
items.answer: Ambos se generan en el servidor; puede descargarlos, enviarlos por correo electrónico al cliente o subir usted mismo la factura electrónica a su plataforma nacional.
